Utopia UP-002 H723 Smart Android 14 Projector (Integrated Android 14 Operating System / 1GB RAM + 8GB Storage / Wireless Wi-Fi & Bluetooth Connectivity / Built-In Speaker / HDMI & USB Ports / Portable Home Theater Display)

Transform any room into an immersive cinema with the Utopia UP-002 H723 Smart Projector, available at Turbo Computer Egypt. Powered by the Android 14 operating system with 1GB RAM and 8GB internal storage, this portable LED projector allows you to stream your favorite movies, apps, and video content directly via Wi-Fi. Featuring versatile HDMI and USB connectivity along with an integrated speaker system, it offers a complete big-screen experience for home entertainment, gaming, and presentations.
